allocation.decision: Set from full rational operations/irrational classification/calculator/application coverage; no baseline default.

prerequisites: Integer signs, fractions, decimals and order of operations; plan a short diagnostic.
materials_plan: Number classification cards including zero, repeating/terminating decimals, radicals and common classification traps.
Combined-operation and reciprocal task sheets, calculator instructions, checked solutions and context data.
Fresh independent final task sheet; no teacher exemplar in student pack.
solutions_plan: Solve every numeric task independently, register deterministic expressions and show units/rounding separately.
State that zero has no reciprocal; distinguish a displayed approximation from an exact rational/irrational value.

assessment_plan.a: Classify exact numbers and justify rational/irrational decisions.
assessment_plan.b: Show combined rational operations and order of operations.
assessment_plan.c: Use a calculator to find/verify reciprocals with nonzero-domain reasoning.
assessment_plan.d: Solve unfamiliar rational-number contexts with correct interpretation and units.
assessment_plan.e: Explain usefulness in a chosen real-life context; record attitude evidence without overclaiming the final rubric.

review_focus: Use fictional or anonymous health-context data; no diagnostic health claims or public body-weight comparisons.
